description: This file defines the DeleteAttributeLiveCommand interface, which provides live command capabilities for deleting an attribute in a scene managed through Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends several interfaces to enable identification of the target thing, command execution, and attribute manipulation, and provides a method to retrieve the JSON pointer of the attribute to delete.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface providing live command functionality for deleting an attribute identified by a JSON pointer, supporting interactions with the Eclipse Ditto framework, including access to the associated thing ID and command lifecycle.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the attribute to delete.
